sloka: सफलो राघवोद्योगः सुग्रीवस्य च संभ्रमः ।शीलमासाद्य सीताया मम च प्रवणं मनः ।। ५.५९.२ ।।।।
transliteration: saphalo rāghavodyogaḥ sugrīvasya ca saṁbhramaḥ ।śīlamāsādya sītāyā mama ca pravaṇaṁ manaḥ ।। 5.59.2 ।।।।

translations.english: "It is due to Rama's exertions, Sugriva's endeavour and Sita's conduct that I have been successful. My devotion to Sita has further deepened.
translations.hindi: उठो-उठो, तुम क्यों मेरे पैरों पर पड़े हुए हो । में तुम्हें भय करता हूं, 'अब जो हाल हो सो सब मुझसे कह दो
